BAGGAGE ALLOWANCE - IN THE U.S.A. -40 Ibs. carried free on each first class or coach
ticket except when travel is part of an international trip by air.
INTERNATIONAL FIRST CLASS -66 Ibs. (30 kilograms) carried free for each full or half
fare first class ticket, including portions of travel in the U.S.A.
INTERNATIONAL ECONOMY CLASS-44 Ibs. (20 kilograms) carried free for each full or
half fare economy class ticket, including portions of travel in the U.S.A.
CHILDREN -Children paying half fare are granted free baggage allowance on the same
basis as a passenger paying the full adult fare. Children traveling free or at the 10% fare
receive no free baggage allowance.
BAGGAGE - EXCESS WEIGHT CHARGES - Baggage weight in excess of the above free allow-
ances shall be charged for as follows:
IN THE U.S. A. - Baggage over 40 Ibs. is charged for at one half of 1% of the piston first
class adult one way fare per pound.
INTERNATIONAL-Excess baggage is charged for at 1% of the first class adult one way fare
per kilogram (2.2 lbs.).
BAGGAGE - EXCESS VALUE — TWA's liability for baggage is limited to its actual value, but
not more than $250 per passenger on trips in the U.S. A. or $16.50 per kilogram for checked
baggage and $330 per passenger for unchecked baggage on international trips, unless a
higher valuation is stated before the flight and a charge of 10g on trips in the U.S.A. or 15¢
on international trips is paid for each extra $100 or fraction thereof claimed.
CHECK-IN FOR FLIGHTS - Our passengers expect on-time performance. Help us keep your
flight on-time. Check in early. Refer to international office listing for check-in time appli-
than 48 hours may claim a duty and tax exemption of $100.00 once each 31 days for mer-
chandise acquired overseas.
FAMILY FARES - IN THE U.S. A. - On flights which are scheduled to depart between Mon-
day noon and Friday 6 AM, your spouse and/or children under 22 may travel with you at ¼
off regular adult first class or coach fares! Family Fare discounts do not apply to economy
GROUND TRANSPORTATION - Taxicab and limousine service available between downtown
scheduled pick-up points and airport, at passenger's expense.
INSURANCE - Trip insurance is available at most airlines offices in the U.S.A.
MEAL SERVICE - For information on Food and Beverage Service, see schedule pages.
NO SHOW PENALTY - INTERNATIONAL - When transportation is wholly between stations in
the area bounded on the west by the Azores and Ireland and on the east by Iran and Saudi
Arabia, passengers who fail to use confirmed space on a flight and do not cancel such space
before flight departure will be assessed a penalty of 25% of the one way fare to destination

CHILDREN - IN THE U.S.A. - (a) One child under 2 years not occupying a seat carried free
with each accompanying fare paying adult passenger. (b) Children under 2 years occupying a
seat, or over 2 years and under 12 years, or more than one child accompanying a passenger
are each charged one half adult fare. (c) Children under 5 years must be accompanied by a
passenger at least 12 years old. Children between 5 and 8 may travel alone only by prior
arrangement. Unaccompanied children between the ages of 5 and 12 will be charged the full
adult fare. INTERNATIONAL - One child under 2 years not occupying a seat carried at 10%
of adult fare with each 'accompanying full fare adult passenger. Children over 2 and under 12
years, a child under 2 occupying a seat, and more than one child accompanying a passenger
are each charged one half adult fare. Children may travel alone only under certain conditions.

RESERVATIONS - Reservations are not definite until tickets are purchased. Passage may
be refused to any person when necessary to comply with Government regulations, tariff
rules, or for reasons beyond the control of TWA.
SCHEDULES - TWA reserves the right to cancel or change schedules without notice. Safety
is our primary consideration. Schedules shown are based on expected flying times. Because
weather and other factors may affect operating conditions, departures and arrivals cannot
be guaranteed.
